verse.text: For the entire law is fulfilled in keeping this one command: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”

reflection.scripture: For the entire law is fulfilled in keeping this one command: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
reflection.observation: Paul simplifies the entire law into one radical command: love your neighbor as yourself. This isn't about rule-keeping—it's about heart transformation. The law wasn't a burden to master but a relationship to live out. When we love others well, we fulfill what God intended all along.
reflection.application: Today, look for one person to love intentionally. It might be a kind word, a patient response, or simply being present. Love isn't always grand gestures—sometimes it's choosing grace in a frustrating moment or listening without fixing. Ask God to show you who needs your love today.
reflection.prayer: Lord, You summed up everything in love. Help me move beyond obligation to genuine care for those around me. Open my eyes to the neighbors You've placed in my path today. Fill me with Your love so I can pour it out freely. In Jesus' name, amen.
